rule: IDs retained; classification changes mandatory scope, not historical evidence

requirements.historical_text: The compiler SHALL retain the user's site boundary, station function, era/profile, service priorities and requested operating capabilities as a versioned brief.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Round-trip serialisation preserves all explicit choices.

requirements.historical_text: It SHALL distinguish hard constraints, preferences, inferred defaults and unknowns.

requirements.historical_text: It SHALL define which changes Python may make autonomously and which require approval.

requirements.historical_text: Rail connections SHALL use typed ports and permitted connectivity, not coordinate coincidence.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A diamond has no invented turning route; separated levels stay separate.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The model SHALL retain direction permissions, operating role, system and traction/gauge compatibility independently.

requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Terrain, structures, track geometry and passenger circulation SHALL share a declared coordinate transform and units.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Round-trip conversion meets a profile-defined numerical tolerance.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Every infrastructure snapshot SHALL have a coherent version and declared valid period.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Old pointwork cannot be silently combined with future signalling.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Observations SHALL carry timestamps, snapshot IDs, coverage and quality status.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Missing telemetry remains unknown rather than interpreted as no trains.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The planner SHALL derive a required movement/eligibility matrix before fitting geometry.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Every mandatory movement has a legal candidate or a specific failure.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: It SHALL support nonuniform platform roles and asymmetric approaches.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A mixed through/bay fixture is not forced into a mirrored fan.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: It SHALL generate grouped ladders and bounded cross-group access as alternatives to universal connectivity.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Alternatives have explicit movement differences and conflict witnesses.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Through-service candidates SHALL include both arrival and departure feasibility.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A reachable platform with an impossible exit is rejected.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Turning and empty-stock movements SHALL be part of the topology requirement when requested.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A passenger-only path count cannot hide an impossible next working.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Grade separation SHALL name the movement conflict being removed and include downstream interfaces.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A relieved crossing is not reported as solved when its queue moves to the next merge.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The model boundary SHALL include consequential junctions and extend or flag itself when queues reach the boundary.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Externalised delay is visible in candidate comparisons.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Independent movements SHALL be demonstrated using resource compatibility, not visual separation alone.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A point/protection conflict can invalidate non-overlapping drawn paths.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The geometry kernel SHALL store plan alignment, vertical profile, curvature and cant separately from engine splines.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Engineering quantities survive export/import within stated tolerance.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Connections SHALL enforce the appropriate position, heading, curvature and grade boundary conditions.
requirements.historical_acceptance: The validator reports the location and magnitude of each discontinuity.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Turnouts and crossings SHALL be catalogue components with complete route geometry and applicability metadata.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A crossing angle alone cannot establish a route speed.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Crossovers, scissors and throat ladders SHALL be solved and checked as complete assemblies.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Individually valid points cannot conceal an invalid connecting reverse curve.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Horizontal, vertical and cant constraints SHALL be checked jointly for the selected train/profile set.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A combined-geometry violation is detected despite valid isolated subchecks.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Vehicle clearance SHALL use a declared swept-envelope model and include structures, adjacent tracks and platform interfaces.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A centreline-only clearance pass cannot override an envelope collision.
requirements.interpretation: Keep practical collision/envelope checks; full certified dynamic/3D gauging is an optional specialist gate, not a blanket ordinary-build blocker.

requirements.historical_text: Platform fitting SHALL distinguish boarding length, track extent, stopping tolerance and any permitted selective-door policy.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A nominally long track cannot count as an adequately long boarding platform.
requirements.interpretation: Use for station/platform/structure tasks; frozen station internals need not be redesigned for a plain-track link.

requirements.historical_text: Flyover/diveunder design SHALL include approach ramps, vertical transitions, structure depth, crossing envelope and terrain/civil reservations.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A clear crossing centre cannot hide an approach or full-envelope conflict.
requirements.interpretation: Required for a requested grade separation; actual supported structures must replace reservation-only mocks.

requirements.historical_text: Passenger structures and access space SHALL be reserved during rail/civil generation.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A pier or ladder cannot silently remove the only permitted passenger path.
requirements.interpretation: Use for station/platform/structure tasks; frozen station internals need not be redesigned for a plain-track link.

requirements.historical_text: Compression, mirroring or engine snapping SHALL trigger relevant revalidation.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A scaled reference is not accepted solely because its unscaled parent passed.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Services SHALL carry train length, performance profile, route eligibility and stopping pattern.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Performance and fit are not inferred from one generic train.
requirements.interpretation: Train length and compatibility core; traction/braking performance detail optional and empirical game behaviour authoritative.

requirements.historical_text: A platform allocation SHALL include arrival route, berth interval, readiness and onward route/activity.
requirements.historical_acceptance: An occupied or inaccessible exit causes an explicit infeasibility result.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Temporal resources SHALL cover running sections, point requirements, crossing zones and modelled protection.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Every conflict explanation names the incompatible requirements.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Release SHALL account for train tail position and the selected route-release model.
requirements.historical_acceptance: The crossing stays unavailable until its relevant release condition holds.
requirements.interpretation: Retain train-tail clearance and waiting-length logic; exact timed signalling release follows the game adapter, not a required new physics model.

requirements.historical_text: Dwell, dispatch and turnround SHALL be separate activities with applicable scenario/profile parameters.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A terminating train cannot depart using only a through-stop dwell.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: Rolling-stock dependencies and empty-stock moves SHALL be represented when enabled.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Delayed incoming stock propagates to its next working unless an explicit substitute exists.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: Reversal, permissive occupation, coupling and splitting SHALL require explicit profile and engine support.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Unsupported behaviours are not achieved by teleportation or duplicate train identities.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: Approach holding positions SHALL have usable length, stopping and release constraints.
requirements.historical_acceptance: An overlength waiting train is not treated as clear of the upstream resource.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The simulator SHALL model queues and blocking across connected stations/junctions.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A downstream dwell perturbation can block an upstream resource.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: Scenario runs SHALL be reproducible using immutable inputs, seeds and model versions.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Replay produces the same deterministic event sequence for a fixed configuration.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: Performance reports SHALL state warm-up, observation horizon, residual queues and completed/cancelled work.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A short horizon cannot hide unfinished trains or delayed spillback.
requirements.interpretation: Apply when the selected operating diagnostic needs it; do not run an independent timetable/stock/spatial-queue simulation for every construction request.

requirements.historical_text: UK-inspired and game-calibrated operating models SHALL remain distinguishable.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A game reservation discrepancy is reported without rewriting the engineering assessment.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The system SHALL maintain a passenger graph separate from rail connectivity.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A pedestrian interchange cannot create a train route.
requirements.interpretation: Keep rail and game passenger connections distinct; do not require a crowd simulator.

requirements.historical_text: Passenger demand SHALL support station entry/exit and service-to-service transfers by time period.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Simultaneous arrivals generate the correct modelled transfer demand.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Walking, waiting, queues and vertical travel SHALL use declared capacities/behaviour profiles, not unlimited instantaneous links.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A constrained connection can become the passenger bottleneck.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Accessible paths SHALL be evaluated independently from unrestricted shortest paths.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Lift failure cannot be “solved” by directing the accessible cohort up stairs.
requirements.interpretation: Use game passenger-access connectivity when a station task requires it; detailed lift/accessible-route simulation deferred.

requirements.historical_text: Platform usable area SHALL exclude reserved edge zones, structures, furniture and circulation obstacles as specified by the selected profile.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Gross area cannot conceal a local pinch point.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Platform reassignment SHALL include announcement/redirection and transfer consequences where the passenger model is enabled.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A late cross-group change has an explicit modelled cost or unassessed flag.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Boarding/alighting and dwell coupling SHALL use calibrated or clearly synthetic assumptions.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Unknown door/boarding behaviour is not presented as measured station performance.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Normal, disturbed and reduced-access scenarios SHALL be reported separately; emergency analysis SHALL not imply certification.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Lift loss, crowd surge and closure scenarios retain their distinct validity status.
requirements.interpretation: Detailed passenger demand/circulation and platform-facility simulation are not first-build prerequisites.

requirements.historical_text: Search SHALL apply hard feasibility checks before preference scoring.
requirements.historical_acceptance: An attractive infeasible candidate cannot beat a feasible one through weighted averaging.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The planner SHALL compare materially different topology families before expensive detailed fitting.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Search does not spend its full budget varying one fundamentally unsuitable fan.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Results SHALL be cached using all correctness-relevant versions and assumptions.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A changed train length, rule issue or capability invalidates affected results.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Local repair SHALL have explicit time/evaluation/attempt budgets and preserve the brief.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Budget exhaustion returns a bounded-search result, not a false impossibility proof.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Candidate evaluation SHALL include disturbances and expose important sensitivity.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A nominal-only success is not labelled robust operation.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: The decision packet SHALL contain a small nondominated set, material trade-offs and an approval question only where needed.
requirements.historical_acceptance: Routine spline retries never become separate Astra decision requests.

requirements.historical_text: A capability manifest SHALL distinguish supported, unsupported and unknown operations, with evidence.

requirements.historical_text: Design output SHALL compile into capability-qualified operations without inventing engine functions.

requirements.historical_text: Each plan SHALL bind to a world version and authorised edit region.

requirements.historical_text: Execution SHALL use staged validation and checkpoints appropriate to actual engine facilities.

requirements.historical_text: Operation IDs and acknowledgements SHALL support reconciliation after timeout/reconnect.

requirements.historical_text: The adapter SHALL report realised assets and mappings back to canonical IDs.

requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Realised geometry, connectivity and required routes SHALL be checked after construction.

requirements.historical_text: Partial failure SHALL preserve a recovery record and stop unsafe automatic continuation.

requirements.historical_text: Full traces SHALL remain local and queryable by stable result references.

requirements.historical_text: Reports SHALL identify bottleneck resources, scenarios, evidence gaps and rejected required movements.

requirements.historical_text: Model calibration SHALL compare predicted and observed metrics with uncertainty and coverage.
requirements.historical_acceptance: A poor or unobservable fit prevents a calibrated-capacity claim.
requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Change-driven observations SHALL support region/time summaries and bounded event digests.

requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Usage experiments SHALL record model interactions, tokens/observations where available, and actual credits only when measured.

requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Every result SHALL distinguish planned, simulated, constructed and observed status.

requirements.interpretation: Retain for the requested construction task; offline evidence does not establish native support.

requirements.historical_text: Conflicting claims SHALL remain visible until resolved by scope/date/evidence.

requirements.historical_text: Reference geometry SHALL identify measured, schematic, estimated and synthetic origins.

requirements.historical_text: Reference-inspired tests SHALL state their synthetic status and avoid real-site capacity claims.
